lines.en: label beachmas14:
scene beachmasgathering1
: You know nobody would hold it against you if you were to ever fuck your sister, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道吧，就算你哪天真跟你姐上床了，也没人会拿这个针对你。

lines.en: : Are you saying that because you actually believe it? Or because you just want someone to say the same thing about you and {i}your{/i} sister?
lines.zh: : 你说这话是真这么想？还是只是想让别人也对你和{i}你{/i}姐说同样的话？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t blame either one of you for nailing your sisters. They’re both hot as Hell and it’s not like you run the risk of inbreeding.
lines.zh: : 你们俩谁上了自己姐姐我都不会怪你们。她们两个都辣到爆，而且你们又不用担心近亲繁殖的问题。

lines.en: : Bad move. Kirin’s been waiting for someone to validate her fantasy of being fucked by her sister for years now and you’ve just opened the floodgates.
lines.zh: : 失策。Kirin 等一个能为她"被姐姐上"的幻想背书的人，已经等了好几年了，你这一下算是把闸门给打开了。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering2
: I do not want my sister to {i}fuck{/i} me, you two.
lines.zh: : 我才不想让我姐{i}上{/i}我，你们两个。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering3
: I want to fuck {i}her.{/i} It’s different.
lines.zh: : 是我想{i}上{/i}她。这不一样。

lines.en: : Oh dayum. She ain’t even hidin’ it.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。她连藏都不藏了。

lines.en: : Just with you two. Don’t tell anybody else.
lines.zh: : 只在你们俩面前这样。别告诉别人。

lines.en: : Am I...one of the girls now?
lines.zh: : 我……现在是女生团的一员了吗？

lines.en: : You’re certainly a special kind of person, Kirin.
lines.zh: : Kirin，你确实是种特别的人。

lines.en: : Oh, please. Like you’ve never masturbated with your sister’s hairbrush before.
lines.zh: : 拜托。好像你从来没拿你姐的梳子自慰过似的。

lines.en: : Niki’s hairbrush was way too big for that sort of thing. I used a marker, like a real {i}distinguished{/i} lady.
lines.zh: : Niki 的梳子对那种事来说太大了。我用的是马克笔，像个真正{i}高雅{/i}的淑女一样。

lines.en: : No wonder she’s head over heels for Sensei. Girl spent her whole life with an XXL hair brush preparing herself for his giant dick.
lines.zh: : 难怪她对老师神魂颠倒。这姑娘一辈子都拿着一把加加大号的梳子，为他的巨根做着准备。

lines.en: : Uhh...hi. Teacher here.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗨。老师在呢。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering4
: I thought you were one of the girls?
lines.zh: : 我以为你已经是女生团的一员了？

lines.en: : I was until you started talking about Senpai’s penis. Now I’m just a very unqualified detective.
lines.zh: : 在你开始聊前辈的鸡巴之前是。现在我只是个非常不合格的侦探。

lines.en: : Oh, I haven’t seen it. Sensei’s a totally respectable adult who only has sex with other adult women. But, let’s be real, we all know he’s packing.
lines.zh: : 哦，我没见过。老师是个完全体面的成年人，只跟成年女性上床。不过说实话，我们都知道他家伙很大。

lines.en: : As your teacher, I’m going to have to ask you to stop saying things like that.
lines.zh: : 作为你们的老师，我必须要求你们别再说这种话了。

lines.en: : But, as one of the girls, you right. He packin’.
lines.zh: : 但作为女生团的一员，你说得对。他家伙确实大。

lines.en: : But wait, what does Noriko’s sister’s hair brush have to do with Senpai?
lines.zh: : 等等，Noriko 姐姐的梳子跟前辈有什么关系？

lines.en: : They dated for years. And if we’re all gonna keep pretending he never tapped that, we might as well check ourselves into a mental institution because that’s just insane.
lines.zh: : 他们交往了好几年。如果咱们还要继续装作他没上过她，那还不如直接把自己送进精神病院，因为那简直疯了。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering5
: Shh! Chika doesn’t know yet! And for the record, I have confirmation from both sources that they never made it that far.
lines.zh: : 嘘！Chika 还不知道呢！而且声明一下，我从双方那儿都得到过确认，他们没走到那一步。

lines.en: : Fine. Whatever. But she’s still probably swallowed more of his jizz than there is water in our bodies.
lines.zh: : 行吧。随便。不过她吞下去的他的精液，大概比我们身体里的水还多。

lines.en: : He...dated {i}her?{/i} That mega-babe on a sparkly stage, singing in front of thousands of people?! Ain’t she a little young?!
lines.zh: : 他……跟{i}她{/i}交往过？那个在闪亮舞台上、对着成千上万人唱歌的超级大美女？！她是不是太年轻了点？！

lines.en: : She’s almost 30.
lines.zh: : 她快三十了。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering6
: Why are there so many hot girls around here who look way younger than they actually are?!
lines.zh: : 为什么这附近这么多辣妹，看着都比实际年龄小那么多？！

lines.en: : And how the fuck are we supposed to compete with an idol?! The hell, Senpai?!
lines.zh: : 还有我们他妈要怎么跟一个偶像竞争啊？！搞什么啊，前辈？！

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering7
: {i}Compete?{/i}
: Are you gunning for Sensei’s affection as well, Imani?
lines.zh: : Imani，你也在追老师吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering8
: Nooooo?...
: Convincing.
lines.zh: : 真有说服力。

lines.en: : No wonder you’ve never accepted any of my advances. You’ve already fallen for the same guy literally everyone else has fallen for.
lines.zh: : 难怪你从来不接我的任何一次示好。你已经爱上那个其他所有人也都爱上的男人了。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering9
: You know, your ability to just deny the truth and make up your own version of shit instead is really something to be marveled at.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你能这么干脆地否认事实、再自己编一个版本出来，这本事真是令人叹为观止。

lines.en: : If you don’t mind me asking...what’s been holding you back?
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意我问一句……是什么在拖着你？

lines.en: : You guys work together...you get along really well...and you’re straight up so beautiful that it makes literally everyone in class jealous.
lines.zh: : 你们一起工作……相处得特别好……而且你真的美到让班上所有人都嫉妒。

lines.en: : Realistically speaking, you’d have a much better chance than any one of us, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 实事求是地说，你的机会比我们任何一个人都大得多，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering10
: Romance is...
lines.zh: : 恋爱这种事……

lines.en: : Well, first and foremost, it’s not a thing I should be discussing with a bunch of teens. Especially teens who are in regular contact with the subject of said romance.
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先，这不是我该跟一群青少年讨论的东西。尤其是那群还经常能接触到这段恋爱对象的青少年。

lines.en: : It’s just...not a thing I’m really {i}good{/i} at. And it’s not a thing Senpai seems particularly interested in to begin with, so...
lines.zh: : 只是……这真的不是我{i}擅长{/i}的事。而且前辈看起来本来也对这事儿没什么兴趣，所以……

lines.en: : Not to mention there ain’t a single person in class who would endorse it even if, by some stretch of imagination, things {i}did{/i} go somewhere other than the friend route.
lines.zh: : 更别说就算想象力再丰富一点，事情{i}真的{/i}发展到了朋友以外的方向，班上也没有一个人会赞同。

lines.en: : I’d endorse it. And watch it repeatedly if it was on film. That sounds hot.
lines.zh: : 我赞同。要是拍下来我还会反复看。听着就很辣。

lines.en: : You’re barely a human. You don’t count.
lines.zh: : 你算不上人。你说话不算数。

lines.en: : Nodoka too. She’s even {i}less{/i} human. But you’ve been laying it on a lot harder than she has, yo.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 也算。她{i}更{/i}不像人。不过你可比她上心得多了，喂。

lines.en: : Why does it matter if we endorse it? You should always follow your heart...even if it means putting the people you care about at risk.
lines.zh: : 我们赞不赞同有什么关系？你应该永远追随自己的心……哪怕那意味着把你在乎的人置于风险之中。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering11
: Guys, I’m glad that I’m apparently young and cool enough to talk to about this...but I really shouldn’t be getting into it right now.
lines.zh: : 各位，我很高兴自己显然年轻又酷到能让你们聊这些……但我现在真的不该掺和进去。

lines.en: : It’s Christmas. We should be hanging out and watching Hot Noriko’s concert. Not discussing why I should be gunning for my senpai’s heart.
lines.zh: : 今天是圣诞节。我们应该一起玩、一起看"辣妹 Noriko"的演唱会。而不是讨论我为什么该去追我前辈的心。

lines.en: : At the end of the day, we’re good friends who work together....and that’s how shit’s going to stay for the indefinite future.
lines.zh: : 说到底，我们是一起工作的好朋友……而且在可预见的未来里，事情就会一直这样。

lines.en: : Or at least until we get really, {i}really{/i} drunk one night and wind up sleeping together and taking shit from there like all {i}real{/i} adults do.
lines.zh: : 或者至少直到哪天晚上我们喝得{i}烂{/i}醉，然后稀里糊涂睡到一起，再像所有{i}真正{/i}的成年人那样从那儿开始。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering12
: But until that happens, I’m just Imani Imai — the hot, fun student teacher who {i}isn’t{/i} boning the other teacher. Even if he {i}is{/i} packing. The end.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，我就是 Imani Imai——那个火辣又有趣、{i}没有{/i}在跟另一个老师上床的实习老师。就算他家伙{i}很大{/i}。说完了。

lines.en: : If that’s what makes you happy, Imani...
lines.zh: : 如果那样能让你开心的话，Imani……

lines.en: : Hmm...
: You know what would make {i}me{/i} happy?
lines.zh: : 你们知道什么会让{i}我{/i}开心吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering13
: Literally anyone boning Senpai and you getting to watch and/or participate?
lines.zh: : 随便谁跟前辈上床，然后你能在旁边看、并且/或者加入？

lines.en: : Well...
: You haven’t exactly been all that reserved about it, Kirin.
lines.zh: : Kirin，你在这事上可一直没怎么藏着掖着啊。

lines.en: : What if I was going to say...something like, “Spending the whole Christmas party hanging out with the two of you?”
lines.zh: : 万一我想说的是……比如"整个圣诞派对都跟你们两个一起过"呢？

lines.en: : While we take turns with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我们轮流跟老师来。

lines.en: : There it is.
lines.zh: : 来了来了。

lines.en: : Hope your Secret Santa gift this year is a chastity belt. You need it.
lines.zh: : 希望你今年的神秘圣诞老人礼物是一条贞操带。你确实需要。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: I’M LATE, I’M LATE, I’M LATE! HOW DID YOU LET THIS HAPPEN?!
lines.zh: : 我迟到了我迟到了我迟到了！你怎么能让这种事发生？！

lines.en: : Why is it suddenly my fault that you’re irresponsible when it comes to time?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然就变成我的错了？明明是你自己对时间一点责任心都没有。

lines.en: : My plans for the day didn’t factor in falling unconscious from spending too long in the sauna!
lines.zh: : 我今天的计划里可没算上在桑拿房待太久会昏过去！

lines.en: : I assume they didn’t factor in the hour you had to spend in the bath afterward as well?
lines.zh: : 我猜也没算上之后你必须在浴缸里泡上的那一小时吧？

lines.en: : I was all sweaty and gross! And so were you! It was a necessary evil!
lines.zh: : 我当时满身是汗、黏糊糊的！你也是！那是必要的恶！

lines.en: : But an entire {i}hour?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可整整{i}一个小时{/i}？

lines.en: scene black
: MOVE OVER! NIKI’S NUMBER ONE FAN COMING THROUGH!
lines.zh: : 让开！NIKI 头号粉丝来了！

lines.en: : HA! Funny joke, Ami! A real number one fan would have cleared her entire schedule to be here from the start!
lines.zh: : 哈！真好笑，Ami！真正的头号粉丝会一早就把整个日程清空，从一开始就守在这儿！

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering14
: Things happened! Things beyond my control! There wasn’t anything I could do!
lines.zh: : 发生了一些事！一些我控制不了的事！我什么也做不了！

lines.en: : Likely story! Now, shut the fuck up! The queen is about to speak!
lines.zh: : 说得倒是好听！现在，给我他妈闭嘴！女王要开口了！

lines.en: : You guys have no idea how glad I am to see you.
lines.zh: : 你们根本不知道我见到你们有多高兴。

lines.en: : First, ya disappear all night...Then, ya disappear all day...If I didn’t know any better, I’d say you were gettin’ dragged along on special event chains, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 先是失踪一整晚……然后又失踪一整天……要不是我了解情况，我真会说你是被特殊事件链拖着走呢，老师。

lines.en: : Did you have fun with Ami, at least? She seemed pretty excited to enact her revengeful “Hang out with me all day” plan this morning.
lines.zh: : 至少你跟 Ami 玩得开心吗？今早她看起来挺兴奋的，要执行她那个报复性的"跟我玩一整天"计划。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if “fun” is the word I’d use. But it was definitely a time nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 我不确定"开心"是不是我会用的词。不过那确实算是一段经历。

lines.en: : What have you guys been up to? Anything interesting happen while I was gone?
lines.zh: : 你们都干什么了？我不在的时候有什么有意思的事发生吗？

lines.en: : Not...particularly...It was...a pretty normal day...
lines.zh: : 没……什么特别的……就是……挺平常的一天……

lines.en: : We just...hung around and...played games and stuff...
lines.zh: : 我们就是……待在一起……打打游戏什么的……

lines.en: : No unexpected run-ins today?
lines.zh: : 今天没有意外的撞见吗？

lines.en: : Hm?...No...Why would-
lines.zh: : 嗯？……没有……为什么会——

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering15
: Sana? What’s up? You look really flushed all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : Sana？怎么了？你突然脸红得厉害。

lines.en: : Yo! Stop shakin’ the Switch or I ain’t ever gettin’ my chicken dinner!
lines.zh: : 喂！别晃 Switch 了，不然我永远吃不到我的吃鸡晚餐！

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering16
: Did something happen with you two? The only time I’ve ever seen Sana with that expression is the time I-
lines.zh: : 你们俩之间出什么事了吗？我唯一一次见 Sana 露出那种表情，是那次我——

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering17
: Ah!
: No way...
lines.zh: : 不会吧……

lines.en: : {i}Sana.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sana。{/i}

lines.en: : You {i}didn’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你该不会{/i}……

lines.en: : Didn’t what? The heck’s goin’ on over here? And how come Sana looks like she just got caught with her pants-
lines.zh: : 不会什么？这边到底怎么回事？还有 Sana 怎么看起来像刚被抓到裤子——

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering18
: I’m leaving and I’m taking my Switch!
lines.zh: : 我走了，Switch 我拿走了！

lines.en: : Ay! I wasn’t done with that, ya friggin’ thief!
lines.zh: : 哎！我还没玩完呢，你这个死小偷！

lines.en: : IT’S MINE!
lines.zh: : 那是我的！

lines.en: : You, uhh...didn’t by any chance...see something you weren’t supposed to...right? Because she still hasn’t lived down when I-
lines.zh: : 你，呃……该不会……看到了什么不该看的……对吧？因为她到现在还没洗清上次我——

lines.en: : I didn’t see anything.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没看到。

lines.en: : Then why is-
lines.zh: : 那为什么——

lines.en: : Hey, ask her. I’m not trying to get anybody in trouble. I just wanted to make sure her day was going smoothly.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你去问她啊。我又不是要找谁麻烦。我只是想确认她今天过得顺不顺利。

lines.en: : By...casually letting {i}her{/i} know that...{i}you{/i} know something...you shouldn’t?
lines.zh: : 通过……若无其事地让{i}她{/i}知道……{i}你{/i}知道一些……你不该知道的事？

lines.en: : All I did was ask a simple question. Sana is the one who interpreted it that way. And if that means accidentally teaching her a lesson about her role as the one who should always be innocent, so be it.
lines.zh: : 我只是问了个简单的问题。是 Sana 自己那么理解的。而如果这能顺带给她上一课，让她明白自己"永远该是纯洁的那一个"的角色定位，那也随它去吧。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering19
: Sensei...she’s a normal girl like the rest of us. Of course she’s going to-
lines.zh: : 老师……她和我们一样是个普通的女孩。她当然会——

lines.en: : Don’t say it. I don’t want to hear it.
lines.zh: : 别说。我不想听。

lines.en: : Sensei...you get out there...and you get me that chicken. You got it?
lines.zh: : 老师……你出去……给我把那只鸡赢回来。明白吗？

lines.en: : No, Miku. I have literally no idea what that means. And put your hands down. The game thing has been gone for a full minute.
lines.zh: : 不，Miku。我真的一点都不知道那是什么意思。还有把手放下。那个游戏机已经走了一整分钟了。

lines.en: : It’s only gone because {i}you let it walk away.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它之所以走了，是因为{i}你放它走的{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s not what-
lines.zh: : 我不是那个——

lines.en: : Uhh...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 呃……老师？

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering20
: Rin? What’s up?
lines.zh: : Rin？怎么了？

lines.en: : Heeeey...soo...
: I am kind of like, thirty...maybe {i}fifteen{/i} seconds away from having a nervous breakdown right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在大概还有……三十秒，也许{i}十五{/i}秒，就要精神崩溃了？

lines.en: : So if you have a few minutes to listen to me yell a whole bunch of reasons you shouldn’t hate me sprinkled with even more that contradict that...uhh...could you maybe follow me into the hallway?
lines.zh: : 所以如果你有几分钟，听我喊一大堆"你不该恨我"的理由，里面还夹杂着更多自相矛盾的……呃……你能不能跟我去一下走廊？

lines.en: : Yeah. I just-
lines.zh: : 好。我只是——

lines.en: : Go. I’ll make sure no one else leaves the room so you guys can be alone. Not like they {i}would{/i} when Niki is playing anyway, but still.
lines.zh: : 去吧。我会确保没别人离开房间，好让你们两个独处。反正 Niki 在表演的时候他们本来也{i}不会{/i}走，不过还是一样。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering21
: Thank you, Ayane. I’ll make it-
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Ayane。我会——

lines.en: : Thank me later. Deal with this first.
lines.zh: : 以后再谢。先把这事处理了。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, right.
lines.zh: : 好……好吧。

lines.en: scene black
I lead the way into the hall and Rin follows closely behind, taking a deep breath once we move through the doors and the music of a girl I once [[probably] loved fades into nothing.
lines.zh: 我带头走进走廊，Rin 紧随其后。穿过门之后，那个我曾经[[大概]]爱过的女孩的音乐渐渐消散，她深吸了一口气。

lines.en: Her breathing is irregular and panicked and it’s clear that she has some sort of bad news to deliver to me...
lines.zh: 她的呼吸急促而慌乱，显然是要告诉我什么坏消息……

lines.en: But considering the fact that there were no confessions this year and Otoha isn’t even here to help create any more problems, I’m not really sure what it could be.
lines.zh: 但考虑到今年没有任何告白，而 Otoha 甚至不在场、没法再制造更多麻烦，我真不确定会是什么事。

lines.en: It’s probably not depression acting up either but, then again, I’ve never really been present when Rin slips {i}into{/i} one of her episodes and-
lines.zh: 大概也不是抑郁症发作，不过话说回来，Rin {i}陷入{/i}那种状态的时候，我从来没真正在场过，而且——

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : Yeah...my bad. Lost in thought.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我的错。走神了。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering22
: Yeah! That’s cool. Cool cool cool cool cool cool. Uhh...........okay. Yeah. Words. I can do words. Rin is good at words.
lines.zh: : 好！挺好。好好好好好好。呃……………好吧。对。词语。我会说话。Rin 很会说话。

lines.en: : Fuck. Shit. Umm...
lines.zh: : 操。妈的。嗯……

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering23
: Right! So...
lines.zh: : 对！那么……

lines.en: : You...You know how we were kind of best friends for a while? Or at least really good friends who you wouldn’t specifically {i}call{/i} best friends because that’s not really a...thing that registers to...uhh...
lines.zh: : 你……你知道我们曾经算是很要好的朋友吧？或者至少是那种你不会特意{i}叫{/i}"最好的朋友"的特别好的朋友，因为那不太算是一个……能进入……呃……

lines.en: : So, anyway! You know how friends know stuff about each other? Like how you knew about my crush on Chika before anybody else? Or how I’m adopted? Stuff like that?
lines.zh: : 总之！你知道朋友之间会知道彼此的事吧？比如你比任何人都早知道我喜欢 Chika？或者我是被领养的？那类的事？

lines.en: : Yeah...do you have a {i}new{/i} secret for me?
lines.zh: : 是啊……你有什么{i}新{/i}秘密要告诉我吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering24
: Uhhhhhhhhh..........not exactly.
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……………也不完全是。

lines.en: : But if it makes things any better, which it probably won’t because anyone with half a brain would leave me out here in the hall to melt into a puddle of gooey, red pulp, I’ll tell you anything you want!
lines.zh: : 不过如果这能让事情好一点——大概也不会，因为但凡有点脑子的人都会把我丢在走廊里，让我化成黏糊糊的红色肉泥——你想知道什么我都告诉你！

lines.en: : Anything you want to know! Anything at all! Because if there’s anything you’ve been wondering-
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么都行！什么都可以！因为如果你心里有什么一直想问——

lines.en: : Are you stalling right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在拖时间吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering25
: Yes! But I can’t help it because I’m scared that this will finally put an end to our relationship since you’re {i}already{/i} on the fence about me and I wouldn’t be able to take that!
lines.zh: : 是的！但我忍不住，因为我怕这件事终于会给我们的关系画上句号——毕竟你{i}本来{/i}就在摇摆，而我承受不了那个！

lines.en: : I’m not “on the fence,” Rin. I’m-
lines.zh: : 我没有"在摇摆"，Rin。我是——

lines.en: : Yes you are! You’ve already called me out for focusing too much on Otoha and avoiding you and even if that’s not what I was trying to do, it’s what happened!
lines.zh: : 你就是！你已经说过我太把心思放在 Otoha 身上、一直在躲你，就算那不是我的本意，事实就是这样！

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Do I have to remind you that I’ve made much bigger fuck-ups in our relationship than you have so far? Or do you want to do the honors again?
lines.zh: : 需要我提醒你吗，在我们的关系里我犯过的错比你到目前为止的大得多？还是你想再来一次？

lines.en: : I don’t care about that anymore! I’m past it! I’ve moved on!
lines.zh: : 那些我都不在乎了！我已经翻篇了！我向前看了！

lines.en: : This is bigger!
lines.zh: : 这次更严重！

lines.en: : Than betraying your trust?
lines.zh: : 比背叛你的信任还严重？

lines.en: : Yes! Because this could ruin {i}everything.{/i} And I didn’t really understand the gravity of it until last night when it started really setting in and- fuck. Fuck fuck fuck.
lines.zh: : 是的！因为这可能毁掉{i}一切{/i}。而我直到昨晚才真正明白事情有多严重，当它开始一点点渗进来的时候——操。操操操。

lines.en: else:
: But that doesn’t mean I’m planning on just dropping you. I have no reason to do that.
lines.zh: : 可这并不意味着我打算就这么甩掉你。我没有理由那么做。

lines.en: : Well, you sure as shit do now! Because this isn’t another one of Rin Rokuhara’s many minor infractions! This is a big fucking deal that could ruin {i}everything{/i} if it gets out. And I mean {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哼，现在你可他妈有了！因为这可不是 Rin Rokuhara 那些小过失中的又一件！这是一件天大的事，一旦泄露就会毁掉{i}一切{/i}。我是说，{i}一切{/i}。

lines.en: : Calm down...take a deep breath.
lines.zh: : 冷静点……深呼吸。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering26
: How?! You told me to stop stalling and that would count as stalling! Should I stall or not stall?! Help me!
lines.zh: : 怎么冷静？！你让我别拖延，可深呼吸也算拖延！我到底该拖延还是不拖延？！帮帮我！

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering27
: I told Otoha about you and Chika!
lines.zh: : 我把你和 Chika 的事告诉 Otoha 了！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : It was an accident, I swear! It just slipped out! And I made her promise not to tell anybody and I trust her but nobody is ever 100%% trustworthy, you know?! Like...what if {i}she{/i} slips next? Then someone {i}else?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那是意外，我发誓！就是不小心说漏嘴了！而且我让她保证不告诉任何人，我也信她，可没有人能做到 100%% 值得信任，你懂吧？！比如……万一{i}她{/i}下次也说漏了呢？然后再传给{i}别人{/i}？

lines.en: : Well...that certainly explains why she was acting differently toward me during the Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这倒确实解释了为什么宿舍大战期间她对我的态度不一样。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering28
: I’m so sorry. I’m so so so sorry. I know how important it is for you to keep all of this stuff under wraps but here I am unwrapping everything like it’s-
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉。我真的真的真的很抱歉。我知道把这些事都捂住对你有多重要，可我却在这儿把一切一层层拆开，就好像——

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering29
: Ha! Christmas! It {i}is{/i} Christmas! Oh, how fucking funny is that?!
lines.zh: : 哈！圣诞节！今天{i}就是{/i}圣诞节！哦，这他妈是有多好笑啊？！

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering30
: And {i}then{/i} there’s Chika! Who’s so in love with you and it’s so adorable and she’s saying all these things about how happy she is and how important it is that no one finds out!
lines.zh: : {i}还有{/i} Chika！她那么爱你，可爱得要命，还说着一堆她有多幸福、以及绝对不能让人发现有多重要的话！

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering31
: And that just makes me even more scared of what the fuck is going to happen if people do!
lines.zh: : 而这只会让我更害怕——万一真被人发现了，到底会发生什么他妈的事！

lines.en: : What if {i}she{/i} loses everything important to her?! And then {i}you{/i} lose {i}everything{/i} in general!
lines.zh: : 万一{i}她{/i}失去了所有对她重要的东西呢？！然后{i}你{/i}失去{i}所有的一切{/i}！

lines.en: : Not to mention poor Futaba who’s wrapped up in all of this too! What’ll happen when I fuck up and let {i}that{/i} slip as well, Sensei?! Why did you keep me around for so long?! I know too much! It’s not safe!
lines.zh: : 更别提可怜的 Futaba，她也被卷进这一切里了！等我又搞砸、把{i}那件事{/i}也说漏嘴了会怎么样，老师？！你为什么还让我在你身边待这么久？！我知道的太多了！这不安全！

lines.en: : It’s okay...
lines.zh: : 没事的……

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering32
: No, it’s not! Everyone I love is about to get hurt and it’s all because of me and I was too caught up in worrying about when Otoha is going to fuck me to even think about it!
lines.zh: : 不，有事！我爱的每个人都要受伤了，而这一切都是因为我，我只顾着担心 Otoha 什么时候才肯跟我上床，连想都没想过这件事！

lines.en: : I love you! I love Chika! And I’m sorry I couldn’t keep it a secret like you wanted me to and I understand if that makes you hate me, but I couldn’t hold it in anymore!
lines.zh: : 我爱你！我也爱 Chika！抱歉我没能像你希望的那样守住这个秘密，如果你因此恨我我也理解，可我真的再也憋不住了！

lines.en: : Otoha hasn’t told anyone yet, has she?
lines.zh: : Otoha 还没告诉任何人，对吧？

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering33
: Oh, god! Are you going to {i}kill{/i} her?
lines.zh: : 哦天啊！你要{i}杀{/i}了她吗？

lines.en: : What? No. Why would you even say something like that?
lines.zh: : 什么？不会。你怎么会说出这种话？

lines.en: : I don’t know! Your life is at stake! People do crazy things when they’re cornered!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！你的命都悬在刀刃上了！人被逼到绝路的时候什么疯狂的事都干得出来！

lines.en: : Rin, I {i}like{/i} Otoha. And even if she’s a bitch to me sometimes, I can talk to her. It’s not the end of the world if she knows.
lines.zh: : Rin，我{i}喜欢{/i} Otoha。就算她有时候对我很刻薄，我还是能跟她谈。她知道也不是世界末日。

lines.en: : It just means I have to...figure out a way to make her not {i}want{/i} to tell anyone.
lines.zh: : 只是意味着我得……想个办法，让她不{i}想{/i}告诉任何人。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering34
: What...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : What does...that mean?
lines.zh: : 那……是什么意思？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But that’s for me to figure out. You’ve done all you can by just telling me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。但那是该我去想的事。你只要告诉我就已经做了你能做的一切。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering35
: Sensei...I know this probably isn’t the right time to do this and that I’m literally insane for suggesting you do {i}anything{/i} after openly putting your whole fucking life at risk...
lines.zh: : 老师……我知道现在大概不是提这个的时候，而我明摆着把你他妈整个人生都置于险境了，还在这时候建议你做{i}什么{/i}，确实疯了……

lines.en: : But I really really really really really think you should stop seeing Futaba. If you cut things off now, Chika might never find out. Because Nodoka knows about that too and...and...
lines.zh: : 可我真的真的真的真的真的觉得你该停止见 Futaba 了。如果你现在就断掉，Chika 也许永远不会发现。因为 Nodoka 也知道那件事，而且……而且……

lines.en: : And Futaba doesn’t love you the way Chika does. It’s totally different.
lines.zh: : 而且 Futaba 爱你不像 Chika 那样。完全不一样。

lines.en: : To Chika, you’re like...her whole life. It’s you and her sister. She {i}needs{/i} you. Futaba will be hurt, sure...but...I don’t think you understand just how bad it would be the other way around.
lines.zh: : 对 Chika 来说，你就像……她的整个人生。是她和她姐姐之外的全部。她{i}需要{/i}你。Futaba 当然会受伤……可是……我觉得你不明白反过来会有多糟。

lines.en: : Thanks for the suggestion, Rin. But that’s not really something I want to talk about with you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的建议，Rin。但这真的不是我想跟你谈的事。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering36
: I understand...of course you wouldn’t want to tell me anything important after all that...
lines.zh: : 我理解……在那之后你当然不会想再告诉我任何重要的事……

lines.en: : But I really..{i}really...{/i}really really really really really {i}am{/i} sorry.
lines.zh: : 可我真的……{i}真的……{/i}真的真的真的真的真的很抱歉。

lines.en: : You are...so...{i}so{/i} important to me in so many ways that even {i}I{/i} don’t understand. But I guess that doesn’t mean much when I don’t understand {i}myself{/i} enough to even keep a fucking secret.
lines.zh: : 你对我……那么……{i}那么{/i}重要，重要到连{i}我自己{/i}都理解不了那么多种方式。不过我想，既然我连{i}自己{/i}都了解得不够、连他妈一个秘密都守不住，这大概也算不上什么。

lines.en: : I just think....
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得……

lines.en: : I think you should keep the ones you treasure most...the closest to your heart.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应该把最珍视的人……放在离心脏最近的地方。

lines.en: : Because when someone like me comes around and sabotages all of that, you’ll-
lines.zh: : 因为当像我这样的人出现、把这一切都搞砸的时候，你会——

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering37
: Can you calm down {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}现在{/i}能冷静下来了吗？

lines.en: : What are you doing?...
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？……

lines.en: : Why would you hug me at a time like this?...
lines.zh: : 这种时候你为什么要抱我？……

lines.en: : You should be telling me I’m too impulsive to be your friend...that you won’t feed me secrets anymore...that I never deserved them in the first place...
lines.zh: : 你该说的是我太冲动、不配当你的朋友……说你不会再给我灌任何秘密……说我一开始就不配知道那些……

lines.en: : So why?...
lines.zh: : 那为什么？……

lines.en: : Why are you holding me?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么抱着我？……

lines.en: : I’m heeding your advice.
lines.zh: : 我在听你的建议。

lines.en: : What?...
: I’m keeping the ones I treasure most the closest to my heart.
lines.zh: : 我在把最珍视的人，放在离心脏最近的地方。

lines.en: scene beachmasgathering38
scene beachmasgathering39
: Homies...forever!
lines.zh: : 好哥们儿……一辈子！

lines.en: scene black
: Homies forever...
lines.zh: : 好哥们儿一辈子……

$ rin_love += 5
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}
